review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen inputs. REQ-001, AC-001–AC-003, exact writable binding scopes, task keys, verification dependency, readiness and evidence stages agree with the original PRD. The source supports locating the parameter declaration and decode-only trim change in core/api.ts; normalizeParams, classic/mini factories and exports already forward the shared parameter type and are appropriately inspection-only owners. Existing encode case normalization, first-entry selection and empty-first-entry fallback match the compatibility expectations. The build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Both regression paths are covered by the supplied test/typecheck configuration, which distinguishes runtime/AOT tests from TypeScript checking. The designated implementer and verifier have appropriate roles, availability and supplied active project-scoped trusted claims, including data.change and the verifier-only testing.verification claim; pending claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. An independent non-executing reviewer is configured. No unresolved material DEC-001 or B/C variant is supplied in this case, so there is no supported decision-stage blocker. Historical operations are explicitly old-bundle context, not candidate evidence for this bundle. Repository, source, team, decision, prompt, model, sampling, budget and policy fingerprints are consistently supplied; the manifest/evaluation digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization explain the differing source fingerprints. This assessment relies on the Service's supplied mechanical bindings and isolation facts, not independent digest recomputation, code execution or new human attestation. The original preparation placeholders do not override the subsequently supplied frozen release and team inputs. No material error or unresolved ambiguity was identified.
